configurations.name: Package Release Zip
configurations.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$vswhere = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('ProgramFilesX86')) 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $vswhere)) { throw 'Visual Studio Installer vswhere.exe was not found.' }; $vsPath = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -property installationPath; if (!$vsPath) { throw 'MSBuild was not found. Install Visual Studio with .NET desktop development.' }; $msbuild = Join-Path $vsPath 'MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe'; & $msbuild '${workspaceFolder}\WindowsVirtualDesktopHelper.sln' /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform='Any CPU' /p:PostBuildEvent= /m; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $dist = '${workspaceFolder}\dist'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dist | Out-Null; $stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $zip = Join-Path $dist \"WindowsVirtualDesktopHelper.Release.Unsigned.$stamp.zip\"; Compress-Archive -LiteralPath '${workspaceFolder}\Source\bin\Release\WindowsVirtualDesktopHelper.exe','${workspaceFolder}\Source\bin\Release\WindowsVirtualDesktopHelper.exe.config' -DestinationPath $zip; Write-Host \"Created $zip\""
